test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: How did periods of isolation and ill health help Darwin in his career?

options.text: He was able to devote time to his research.
He was resting and getting cured of his chronic ill health.
He was free to teach and do administrative work.
He and his wife could spend time together and visit their relatives.

solution:
The correct answer is **'He was able to devote time to his research.'**
